text:
Palladium Price in 2010
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2010, the LBMA palladium price rose 90.2% between 2010-01-29 ($419) and 2010-12-30 ($797). The highest sampled price was $797 in December and the lowest was $419 in January. The mean of these observations was $541. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
